text:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to decide billing/routing semantics for the rerank endpoint when we do model hedging/slab routing. Product asks: predictable tenant costs + useful console telemetry. Who has bandwidth to decide tradeoffs?

Tom: Short question first — do we bill for requested fanout (client topK) or for the actual number of candidates evaluated? e.g., client requests 100, we early-stop at 20. bill 100 or 20? :thinking_face:

Ria: Historically we've billed actual work. For rerank I propose: bill on actual evaluated candidates per-model. That maps to real GPU cycles and avoids surprise. Metric name suggestion: `rerank.score_units_evaluated`.

Maya: Two wrinkles: (1) hedging duplicates work across primary+fallback (we might eval same candidates twice) and (2) console UX — product wants a predictable "quota" impression (teams like to see what they asked for, not just what ran).

Tom: For hedging duplicate work we have options:
- bill both evaluations (simple, accurate for ops)
- dedupe and bill only the first evaluation (better for customers, more infra)

I'd prefer dedupe by default with opt-out. We can tag evaluations with a short-lived request_id cache to detect duplicates.

Ria: Implementation sketch: keep a per-request dedupe key (sha1(request_id + candidate_id)). Cache entries expire 1s. If fallback tries to eval same candidate and key exists, skip eval & mark as `deduped=true` in telemetry. New metrics: `rerank.eval_dedup_count`, `rerank.model_hedge_rate`.

Maya: UX: default billing = actual evaluated AFTER dedupe. Console should display both: `requested_topk` (what caller asked) and `billed_evals` (what we charged). Also show estimated cost if no dedupe applied so teams can simulate costs. Add alert: if hedging causes >20% cost delta vs baseline send a flag.

Tom: API exposure idea — add header or param so customers can opt into different billing affinity: `X-Redwood-Billing-Affinity: primary|both|dedupe` or request param `billing_affinity`. Default = `dedupe`. Example: 

```http
POST /v1/rerank
X-Redwood-Billing-Affinity: dedupe
{ "candidates": 100, "model": "ranker-v1" }
```

Maya: That looks good. Product asked that canary tenants (A/B) should still see their requested_topk in the console so they can compare quality vs cost.

Ria: Ops note — dedupe cache adds state: we need to scale eviction and ensure multi-replica visibility. Simpler approach: sticky routing so hedged requests for same tenant go to same rack where cache lives. If not possible, dedupe best-effort and mark `dedupe_best_effort=true` in telemetry.

Tom: Console changes for @frontend: stacked area chart per-tenant with layers: primary_cost, fallback_cost, dedup_credit (negative). Metric keys: `rerank.cost_primary_tokens`, `rerank.cost_fallback_tokens`, `rerank.dedup_credit`. Also add `rerank.estimated_requested_cost`.

Maya: Next steps:
- Ria: open API PR to add header+request field + server-side dedupe sketch (assign)
- Tom: add console mockups + new metrics to telemetry spec
- Maya: write a short RFC describing default = dedupe billing, fallback = both if tenant opts in

Ria: I'll file the PR this afternoon and include the cache/backpressure concerns.

Tom: I'll mock dashboard and add sample query for Grafana panels.

Maya: Thanks — let's aim to ship beta for a few internal tenants next week. :thumbsup:
